tags.feature: Added Stockpile gamemode
Added tutorial level when you launch Aerial Aces for the first time
Hardpoints now drop as actual physics objects
Team color is now indicated by hud color (this can be disabled in settings)

tags.bug: Smoothed out lobby/spectator camera motion
Times now save correctly in practice mode
Chat GUI looks "less" ugly
Can now restart from settings menu in practice mode
Fixed weapons clipping the camera when deploying
Teamscore now resets properly on round end
Removed negligent discharges while equipping a new hardpoint

Hardpoint equip control scheme is more intuitive now. Click on the side you want to equip the hardpoint to, or leave cursor in the center of the screen and press the mouse button corresponding to the side you want to equip to.

tags.balance_change: Anti Material Gun and Rotary Gun damages increased slightly

tags.bug: Removed fall damage when deploying
Scoreboard now shows all team scores the first time it is opened
Players are now removed from the scoreboard when they disconnect from a server
Possibly improved player synchronization in multiplayer
Resolution settings now take effect when game is launched, instead of requiring a toggle from fullscreen to windowed.
Fixed sliding on water if not gliding but still land at correct angle. Previously even if you had a shallow enough angle, you wouldn't be able to slide on the water unless you were gliding.
Fixed audio bug with rotary gun, where sometimes the reverb sound would play even when you weren't just shooting.
Fog no longer effects HUD UI
Improved player character texture, slightly

notes.title: [1.1.4] Patch Notes
notes.content:
Added quality of life improvements, adjusted movement, and fixed some weapon bugs.

[b]MOVEMENT[/b]
[list]
[*] Can now glide immediately on deploy
[*] Widened acceptable glide angle to begin sliding on water
[*] Water rocket movement is now controlled by [SPACE BAR]
[*] Gain rocket fuel slightly faster
[*] Use rocket fuel slightly slower
[/list]

[b]WEAPONS[/b]
[list]
[*] Lowered auto cannon fire rate
[*] Automatic weapons no longer fire constantly after player dies
[*] Fixed rocket launcher
[*] Lowered "rat damage" from 5 to 0.1
[*] Lowered damage of all weapons slightly
[*] Grenades now instantly explode when impacting player
[*] Can now shoot while sliding on water
[*] Can now transition to a slide without gliding first using [CTRL]
[/list]

[b]MAPS[/b]
[list]
[*] Added out of bounds clips to all maps
[*] Added health packs to all maps
[*] Adjusted layout of tp_atrium
[/list]

[b]QUALITY OF LIFE[/b]
[list]
[*] Restart control [R] added to practice gamemode (no longer need to exit to menu)
[*] Can now equip weapons quickly buy pressing mouse buttons in equip menu
[*] HUD transparency can now be controlled in the settings menu
[*] Hit and kill sound effects added
[*] Can no longer join server if IP address is invalid
[/list]

[b]MISC[/b]
[list]
[*] Tightened player hitbox slightly
[*] Removed static shader effect on player death
[*] Ammo and rocket fuel are now refilled on redeploy
[/list]
